'''Regina Sandra Burachik''' is an [[Argentina|Argentine]]<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-previdencia/pt-br/mtp|title=Ministério do Trabalho e Previdência|website=Ministério do Trabalho e Previdência|access-date=22 March 2023|archive-date=22 March 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230322195151/https://www.gov.br/trabalho-e-previdencia/pt-br/mtp|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[mathematician]] who works on [[Mathematical optimization|optimization]] and [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]] (particularly: [[convex analysis]], [[functional analysis]] and non-smooth analysis). Currently, she is a professor at the [[University of South Australia]].<ref>[http://www.unisanet.unisa.edu.au/staff/Homepage.asp?Name=regina.burachik Unisanet: Burachick]</ref>

She earned her Ph.D. from the [[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]] in 1995 under the supervision of [[Alfredo Noel Iusem]] (''Generalized Proximal Point Method for the Variational Inequality Problem'').<ref>{{MathGenealogy|name=Regina Sandra Burachik|id=69795}}</ref> In her thesis, she "introduced and analyzed solution methods for [[Variational inequality|variational inequalities]], the latter being a generalization of the [[Convex optimization|convex constrained optimization problem]]."<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cos.ufrj.br/seminarios/2014/|title=Ciclo de Seminários|work=Federal University of Rio de Janeiro: PESC|access-date=2025-09-07}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
===Articles===
*with [[Alfredo Noel Iusem|A. N. Iusem]] and B. F. Svaiter. "Enlargement of monotone operators with applications to variational inequalities", ''Set-Valued Analysis''
*with A. N. Iusem. "A generalized proximal point algorithm for the variational inequality problem in a Hilbert space", ''SIAM Journal on Optimization''
*with A. N. Iusem. "Set-valued mappings & enlargements of monotone operators", ''Optimization and its Applications''
*with B. F. Svaiter. "Maximal monotone operators, convex functions and a special family of enlargements", ''Set-Valued Analysis''

===Books===
*With Iusem: ''Set-Valued Mappings and Enlargements of Monotone Operators'' (2007)
*''Variational Analysis and Generalized Differentiation in Optimization and Control'' (2010, as editor)
